scope_policy: Keep all five classes through production NMS; score only complete GT classes per image; unknown predictions excluded, not counted as FP.
limitations: Targets are internal optimization objectives, not user acceptance or guaranteed validation precision.
No new zebra calibration GT: class2 remains baseline .25, notcalibrated.
Legacy zebra validation has historical exposure; upstream human status is inherited, not newly certified.
FP/1000 denominator is each class known-scope images; no global zebra FP claim on BDD.
Observed image/group disjointness does not prove geographic scene independence.

objective.selection: lowest threshold satisfying all objectives; otherwise best precision under recall and support constraints; no threshold 1.0
